If you'd like, just confirm which order and items you'd like to return (e.g., the Bookshelf or Jigsaw Puzzle from #W6239298, or the Bookshelf from #W8660475), and the payment method for the refund (your original Mastercard credit card or an existing gift card), and I'll set that up.
